title: National Service Registration, Posting & Clearance
description: The mandatory post-graduate roadmap under Act 426 to register your NSS PIN, verify biometric identity, secure regional user postings, submit monthly assessment forms, and obtain the National Service Certificate.

steps.title: Link Biometric Ghana Card with NIA
steps.why: The National Service Authority (NSA) mandates biometric matching of the graduate's Ghana Card to prevent identity fraud and ensure monthly allowance disbursements.
steps.do_this_when: Before purchasing an NSS pin code or initiating portal registration.

options.label: National Identification Authority Portal
options.notes: Confirm your Ghana Card pin matches your tertiary graduate record.

steps.title: NSS PIN Code Activation & Online Registration
steps.why: All graduates must activate their institutional PIN code and complete their detailed biographical and regional preference submissions on the NSA portal.
steps.do_this_when: Once the National Service Authority opens the annual enrollment window.

options.label: National Service Authority Registration Portal
options.notes: Official portal to activate NSS pin code and complete registration.

steps.title: Check Posting & Secure User Agency Endorsement
steps.why: Personnel must download appointment letters, present them to their assigned user agency (school, hospital, ministry, or private firm) for endorsement, and submit them at the NSA regional center.
steps.do_this_when: Following national release of annual postings.

options.label: NSA Dashboard Posting Check
options.notes: Download official posting letters and regional validation forms.

steps.title: Submit Monthly Duty Assessment Sheets
steps.why: Supervisors must sign the monthly performance and attendance assessment to authorize payment of monthly service personnel allowances.
steps.do_this_when: By the 15th of each active service month.

options.label: Monthly Evaluation Portal
options.notes: Upload signed supervisor duty assessment form.

steps.title: Final Annual Clearance & Certificate Collection
steps.why: Upon completing 12 calendar months of statutory service, personnel obtain the National Service Certificate required for all formal employment and public sector postings in Ghana.
steps.do_this_when: At the conclusion of the service year.

options.label: NSS Certificate Verification & Dispatch
options.notes: Request and track delivery of your authenticated National Service Certificate.
